notes:
# v1.4.16 - compact reading bar and correct covers when switching sources

- Fixed: the reading bar no longer leaves an empty band above its controls. It
  was reserving 28px for a status bar that many devices do not have, and that
  Android hides entirely while reading, so the space was pure padding. It now
  reserves only the inset the device actually reports.
- Fixed: switching to another source now updates the title's cover. The image
  was painted once when the page opened and never refreshed, so the previous
  source's thumbnail stayed on screen even when the new source had none of its
  own. Switching to a source without a cover now shows the placeholder instead
  of the old image.
- Fixed: the cover shown after a source switch is also the one saved to your
  Library, so a title no longer keeps the wrong thumbnail after you bookmark it.
- Note: no action needed - just update.
